test_a_unit_is_rented_only_after_the_one:
for k in range(units - 1):
        fleet.model.add_linear_constraint(fleet.y[k] >= fleet.y[k + 1], name=f"rent_in_order_{k}")
test_site_number_n_goes_to_one_of_the_fi:
for n, s in enumerate(days):
        # Site number n is served by one of the units 0..n (its served row then leaves the rest at 0).
        fleet.model.add_linear_constraint(sum(fleet.x[s, k] for k in range(min(n + 1, units))) == 1,
                                          name=f"site_order_{s}")
test_a_lighter_first_unit_stays_allowed:
fleet.model.add_linear_constraint(fleet.y[k] >= fleet.y[k + 1], name=f"rent_in_order_{k}")
        fleet.model.add_linear_constraint(fleet.y[k] >= fleet.y[k + 1], name=f"rent_in_order_{k}")
        fleet.model.add_linear_constraint(sum(d * fleet.x[s, k] for s, d in days.items())
                                          >= sum(d * fleet.x[s, k + 1] for s, d in days.items()), name=f"load_order_{k}")
